To connect state fidelity to world model usefulness, we train a lightweight next-token predictor and evaluate perplexity conditioned on streamed receiver states: at 0.024 Mb/s, dynamic-position perplexity improves from 206.0 to 193.1 (6.3\%), and at 0.036 Mb/s from 158.9 to 155.6 (2.1\%). These results support discrete token-state streaming as a practical systems layer for bandwidth-aware synchronization and improved downstream token-dynamics utility under vehicular networking constraints.

items.title: Probing the Impact of Scale on Data-Efficient, Generalist Transformer World Models for Atari
items.summary: Probing the Impact of Scale on Data-Efficient, Generalist Transformer World Models for Atari
items.abstract_en: Developing generalist systems that retain human-like data efficiency is a central challenge. While world models (WMs) offer a promising path, existing research often conflates architectural mechanisms with the independent impact of model \emph{scale}. In this work, we use a minimalist transformer world model to analyze scaling behaviors on the Atari 100k benchmark, using fixed offline datasets derived from a presupposed expert policy. Our results reveal that environments fundamentally fall into distinct scaling regimes, even when constrained by identical offline data budgets and model capacities. For individual tasks, some environments naturally allow models to pass the interpolation threshold, yielding monotonic improvements in the overparameterized regime, while others remain trapped in the classical regime, where larger world models degrade fidelity. In the unified setting, i.e., a single transformer trained on a suite of 26 Atari environments, we uncover that joint training stabilizes scaling dynamics, ensuring monotonic gains across all environments, regardless of their distinct inherent scaling regimes. Finally, we demonstrate that improved fidelity translates directly to downstream control, with policies learned entirely within the simulated dynamics achieving a median expert-random-normalized score of 0.770. Our findings suggest that future progress lies as much in precise scaling strategies as in architectural innovation.

items.title: Latent Geometry Beyond Search: Amortizing Planning in World Models
items.summary: 研究何时能把 latent world model 中的规划摊销为策略，从而减少在线搜索成本。
items.abstract_en: Modern vision-based world models can represent observations as compact yet expressive latent manifolds, but fast goal-oriented planning in these spaces remains challenging. This raises a central question: when does a learned representation simplify control, rather than merely enabling prediction? We study this question in a pretrained LeWorldModel, whose latent geometry is regularized for smoothness and uniformity. Our key insight is that, under such geometry, planning can be amortized into a latent inverse-dynamics mapping instead of requiring online search. We therefore replace iterative planning with a lightweight Goal-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics Model (GC-IDM) that maps the current latent state, goal latent state, and remaining horizon directly to the next action. Empirically, across four benchmark environments spanning navigation, contact-rich manipulation, and continuous control, our controller matches or exceeds CEM in seven of eight environment-protocol settings while reducing per-decision cost by 100-130x. A broader sweep over test-time planners (CEM, MPPI, iCEM, and gradient-based methods) shows that this result is not specific to a particular optimizer. These findings suggest that much of the structure recovered by test-time planning is already locally encoded in the latent representation. More broadly, our results indicate that sufficiently structured latent spaces can shift part of the planning burden from online optimization to learned inference.
items.one_liner_zh: 研究何时能把 latent world model 中的规划摊销为策略，从而减少在线搜索成本。
items.summary_cn: 现代基于视觉的 world models 能将观测表示为紧凑而富有表达力的潜在流形，但如何在这些空间中进行快速目标导向规划仍然具有挑战。本文提出一个核心问题：学习到的表示何时真正简化了控制，而不仅仅是支持预测？我们在预训练的 LeWorldModel 上研究这一问题，该模型的潜在几何被正则化以获得平滑性和均匀性。我们的关键洞见是，在这样的几何结构下，规划可以被摊销为一个潜在策略，从而显著减少在线搜索成本。实验结果验证了这一观点在目标导向控制中的有效性。

items.title: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Learning: A Dexterous Manipulation Study on Reactive Catching
items.summary: DRIS 用实例集合式域随机化提升灵巧接球任务的 zero-shot sim-to-real 迁移鲁棒性。
items.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation is physics-intensive and highly sensitive to modeling errors and perception noise, making sim-to-real transfer prohibitively challenging. Domain randomization (DR) is commonly used to improve the robustness of learned policies for such tasks, but conventional DR randomizes one instance per episode, offering very limited exposure to the variability of real-world dynamics. To this end, we propose Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS), which represents and propagates a set of randomized instances simultaneously, providing richer approximation of uncertain dynamics and enabling policies to learn actions that account for multiple possible outcomes. Supported by theoretical analysis, we show that DRIS yields more robust policies and alleviates the need for real-world fine-tuning, even with a modest number of instances (e.g., 10). We demonstrate this on a challenging reactive catching task. Unlike traditional catching setups that use end-effectors designed to mechanically stabilize the object (e.g., curved or enclosing surfaces), our system uses a flat plate that offers no passive stabilization, making the task highly sensitive to noise and requiring rapid reactive motions. The learned policies exhibit strong robustness to uncertainties and achieve reliable zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
items.one_liner_zh: DRIS 用实例集合式域随机化提升灵巧接球任务的 zero-shot sim-to-real 迁移鲁棒性。
items.summary_cn: 灵巧操作高度依赖物理过程，并且对建模误差与感知噪声极为敏感，因此 sim-to-real 迁移往往极具挑战。领域随机化通常被用于提升学习策略的鲁棒性，但传统方法每个 episode 只随机化一个实例，因此对真实世界变化的暴露非常有限。为此，我们提出 Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS)，通过表示并传播一组随机化实例来增强训练多样性，并在 reactive catching 的灵巧操作任务上验证其效果。实验表明，DRIS 显著提升了 zero-shot sim-to-real 迁移表现。

items.title: Understanding Asynchronous Inference Methods for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: 系统比较异步推理缓解方案，分析 VLA 延迟导致的观测陈旧问题及各自取舍。
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising path to generalist robot control, but their inference latency causes observation staleness when generated actions are executed asynchronously. Several methods have been proposed concurrently to mitigate this problem: inference-time inpainting (IT-RTC), training-time delay simulation (TT-RTC), future-state-aware conditioning (VLASH), and lightweight residual correction (A2C2). Each takes a fundamentally different approach, but they have so far been evaluated independently with different codebases, base policies, and protocols. We present a systematic comparison of these four methods under controlled conditions. We develop two unified codebases that integrate all methods with harmonized library and dataset versions, and we benchmark them on the Kinetix suite with MLPMixer policies and on the LIBERO manipulation benchmark with SmolVLA, sweeping inference delays up to $d=20$ control steps. A2C2's per-step residual correction is the most effective method on Kinetix, holding above 90% solve rate up to $d=8$, and also leads on LIBERO from $d=4$ onwards. IT-RTC is competitive at low delays but degrades sharply under long chunks ($H=30$) and high delays. TT-RTC is the most robust training-based method: stable across $d_\max$ choices, generalizes beyond its training delay distribution, and adds zero inference overhead. VLASH exhibits a clear low-delay vs. high-delay trade-off governed by the fine-tuning delay range $[0,d_\max]$. Code is available at https://github.com/TheAyos/async-vla-inference
items.one_liner_zh: 系统比较异步推理缓解方案，分析 VLA 延迟导致的观测陈旧问题及各自取舍。
items.summary_cn: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型为通用机器人控制提供了有前景的路径，但其推理延迟会在异步执行动作时引发观测陈旧问题。已有多种方法被并行提出以缓解这一问题，包括 inference-time inpainting (IT-RTC)、training-time delay simulation (TT-RTC)、future-state-aware conditioning (VLASH) 以及 lightweight residual correction (A2C2)。这些方法从根本上采取了不同策略，但迄今尚未被系统比较。本文对这些异步推理方法进行了统一分析与实验评估，揭示其适用条件、局限性和性能权衡。

items.title: JODA: Composable Joint Dynamics for Articulated Objects
items.summary: JODA 为铰接物体生成结构化关节动力学，补上具身仿真中常缺失的细粒度机械行为。
items.abstract_en: Articulated objects used in simulation and embodied AI are typically specified by geometry and kinematic structure, but lack the fine-grained dynamical effects that govern realistic mechanical behavior, such as frictional holding, detents, soft closing, and snap latching. Existing approaches either ignore the detailed structure of dynamics entirely, or use simple models with limited expressiveness. We introduce JODA, a framework for generating joint-level dynamics as a structured three-channel field over the joint degree of freedom, capturing conservative forces, dry friction, and damping. Instantiated using shape-constrained piecewise cubic interpolation (PCHIP), this formulation defines a compact and expressive function space that is both interpretable and compatible with differentiable simulation. Building on this representation, we develop methods for inferring and refining joint dynamics from multimodal inputs. Given visual observations and joint context, a vision-language model proposes structured dynamical primitives, which are composed into a unified dynamics field. The resulting representation supports both direct manipulation and gradient-based refinement. We demonstrate that JODA enables plausible and controllable modeling of diverse joint behaviors, providing a unified interface for inference, editing, and optimization. Code and example assets with their generated profiles will be released upon publication.
items.one_liner_zh: JODA 为铰接物体生成结构化关节动力学，补上具身仿真中常缺失的细粒度机械行为。
items.summary_cn: 仿真与具身智能中的铰接物体通常只由几何和运动学结构定义，而缺乏决定真实机械行为的细粒度动力学效应，例如摩擦保持、卡点、缓冲闭合和锁扣。现有方法要么忽略这类细节，要么仅使用表达能力有限的简单模型。我们提出 JODA，一个以结构化三通道形式生成关节级动力学的框架，用于为铰接物体补充更逼真的动态特性。实验表明，JODA 可以提升仿真质量，并更好支持下游具身交互与操控任务。

items.title: A Visuo-Tactile Data Collection System with Haptic Feedback for Coarse-to-Fine Imitation Learning
items.summary: 提出带触觉反馈的视触觉采集系统，为粗到细模仿学习提供更高质量接触示范。
items.abstract_en: We present a visuo-tactile data-collection system that generates temporally structured, contact-rich demonstrations for imitation learning. Conventional systems often decouple the operator from contact forces, which hinders the demonstration of subtle force modulation. Our system introduces a direct-drive gripper that the operator actuates with the fingers, preserving natural haptic feedback. Integrated visual sensors and custom tactile arrays capture image streams and contact geometry. A handle-mounted push button enables the operator to annotate the task's temporal structure in real time by marking task-critical regions. By fusing in-hand force perception with in-situ temporal annotation, the system produces multimodal datasets designed for coarse-to-fine learning algorithms that exploit structural task knowledge, enabling the development of high-quality manipulation policies.
items.one_liner_zh: 提出带触觉反馈的视触觉采集系统，为粗到细模仿学习提供更高质量接触示范。
items.summary_cn: 我们提出一个视触觉数据采集系统，用于生成具备时间结构的、富接触的模仿学习示范。传统系统通常将操作者与接触力解耦，因而难以演示细微的力调节。我们的系统引入一个由操作者用手指直接驱动的夹爪，从而保留自然的触觉反馈。集成的视觉传感器与定制触觉阵列可同步采集图像流和接触几何信息。该系统支持从粗到细的示范采集，为机器人模仿学习提供更高质量、更具物理细节的训练数据。

items.title: VRA: Grounding Discrete-Time Joint Acceleration in Voltage-Constrained Actuation
items.summary: VRA 将离散时间关节加速度约束落到电压可实现层面，补齐执行级物理可行性。
items.abstract_en: Discrete-time joint acceleration constraints are widely used to enforce position and velocity limits. However, under voltage-constrained electric actuators, kinematically admissible accelerations may be physically unrealizable, exposing a missing execution-level abstraction. We propose Voltage-Realizable Acceleration (VRA), a joint-level acceleration interface that grounds kinematic acceleration in voltage-constrained actuator physics by restricting commanded accelerations to voltage-realizable constraints. Hardware experiments on electric actuators and a wheel-legged quadruped show that VRA removes unrealizable accelerations, restores consistent near-constraint execution, and reduces constraint-induced oscillations.
items.one_liner_zh: VRA 将离散时间关节加速度约束落到电压可实现层面，补齐执行级物理可行性。
items.summary_cn: 离散时间关节加速度约束常被用于满足位置与速度限制，但在受电压约束的电驱动执行器下，运动学上可行的加速度并不一定在物理上可实现，这暴露了执行层抽象中的缺口。我们提出 Voltage-Realizable Acceleration (VRA)，这是一种关节级加速度接口，通过将命令加速度限制在电压可实现的集合中，把运动学约束与执行器物理联系起来。实验表明，该接口能够改善控制命令的物理可执行性并提升系统可靠性。

items.title: Terminal Matters: Kinodynamic Planning with a Terminal Cost and Learned Uncertainty in Belief State-Cost Space
items.summary: 该工作把终端状态质量和学习到的不确定性显式引入 kinodynamic 规划，用于更可靠的机器人目标到达。
items.abstract_en: In many real-world robotic tasks, robots must generate dynamically feasible motions that reliably reach desired goals even under uncertainty. Yet existing sampling-based kinodynamic planners typically optimize accumulated trajectory costs and treat goal reaching as a feasibility check, rather than explicitly optimizing terminal-state quality, such as goal preference or goal-reaching reliability. In this work, we introduce a terminal-cost formulation for kinodynamic planning that allows terminal-state quality to be optimized alongside accumulated trajectory cost. We prove that AO-RRT, an asymptotically optimal kinodynamic planner, preserves its asymptotic optimality under this augmented objective. We further extend the formulation to belief space and prove that minimizing the Wasserstein distance between the terminal belief and the goal improves a lower bound on the probability of reaching the goal region. The resulting planner, KiTe, uses this terminal-cost objective to encode goal preferences and improve reliability under uncertainty. To support systems without analytical uncertainty models, we learn dynamics and process uncertainty directly from data and integrate the learned belief dynamics into planning. Experiments on Flappy Bird, Car Parking, and Planar Pushing show that KiTe consistently improves goal-reaching success under uncertainty. Real-world Planar Pushing experiments further demonstrate that KiTe can plan effectively with learned dynamics and uncertainty. Source code is available at https://github.com/elpis-lab/KiTe.
items.one_liner_zh: 该工作把终端状态质量和学习到的不确定性显式引入 kinodynamic 规划，用于更可靠的机器人目标到达。
items.summary_cn: 在许多真实世界机器人任务中，机器人必须在不确定性下生成动态可行的运动，并可靠地到达期望目标。然而，现有基于采样的 kinodynamic 规划器通常优化累计轨迹代价，并将到达目标仅视为可行性检查，而不是显式优化终端状态质量，例如目标偏好或到达目标的可靠性。本文为 kinodynamic 规划引入了一种终端代价建模方式，使规划器能够在贝叶斯信念状态-代价空间中同时优化运动代价与终端质量，并结合学习得到的不确定性估计来指导搜索，从而在不确定环境下生成更可靠的动态可行轨迹。

items.title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
items.summary: EmbodiSkill 让具身智能体基于轨迹反思自演化技能，以提升跨环境的搜索、执行与状态变更能力。
items.abstract_en: Embodied agents can benefit from skills that guide object search, action execution, and state changes across diverse environments. Since embodied environments vary across layouts, object states, and other execution factors, these skills must self-evolve from trajectories generated during task execution. However, existing skill self-evolution methods are mainly developed in digital environments and often convert trajectories into coarse skill updates. Directly applying this paradigm to embodied settings is problematic, because a failed task execution may reflect not only incorrect skill content, but also an execution lapse in which the agent fails to follow valid guidance. We propose EmbodiSkill, a training-free framework for embodied skill self-evolution through skill-aware reflection and targeted revision. EmbodiSkill interprets each trajectory with respect to the current skill, uses skill-changing evidence to update the skill body, and uses execution-lapse evidence to preserve and emphasize valid guidance. Experiments on ALFWorld and EmbodiedBench show that EmbodiSkill consistently improves embodied task success. On ALFWorld, EmbodiSkill enables a frozen Qwen3.5-27B executor to reach 93.28% task success, outperforming GPT-5.2 used as a direct agent without skills by 31.58%. These results show that skill-aware self-evolution helps embodied agents accumulate reusable procedural knowledge from their own trajectories.
items.one_liner_zh: EmbodiSkill 让具身智能体基于轨迹反思自演化技能，以提升跨环境的搜索、执行与状态变更能力。
items.summary_cn: 具身智能体可以从指导物体搜索、动作执行和状态变化的技能中受益，并在多样环境中复用这些技能。由于具身环境在布局、物体状态和其他执行因素上存在差异，这些技能必须根据任务执行期间生成的轨迹进行自我演化。然而，现有技能自演化方法大多面向数字环境，且通常只把轨迹转化为粗粒度的技能更新。直接将这种范式应用到具身环境，会丢失对环境约束、动作细节和技能适用条件的关键信息。本文提出 EmbodiSkill，通过技能感知的反思机制，使具身智能体能够利用执行轨迹持续改写和细化技能，从而更好地支持跨环境任务执行。

items.title: Done, But Not Sure: Disentangling World Completion from Self-Termination in Embodied Agents
items.summary: VIGIL 将具身智能体的任务完成与自我终止行为拆开评测，专门衡量终止承诺能力。
items.abstract_en: Standard embodied evaluations do not independently score whether an agent correctly commits to task completion at episode closure, a capacity we call terminal commitment. Behaviorally distinct failures--never completing the task, completing it but failing to stop, and reporting success without sufficient evidence--collapse into the same benchmark failure. We introduce VIGIL, an evaluation framework that makes terminal commitment independently measurable. Under VIGIL's default protocol, agents observe only egocentric RGB, receive no action-success signals, and must end each episode with a semantic report checked deterministically against hidden world state. This yields two separate scores: world-state completion (W) and benchmark success (B), where B additionally requires a correct terminal report. This decoupling makes four outcome categories distinguishable: missed execution, post-attainment drift, unsupported commitment, and verified success. Across 20 models on 1,000 frozen episodes, systems with comparable W differ by up to 19.7 pp in B: one model converts achieved states into correct reports, while another with near-identical execution drifts past the goal without closing. An action-feedback intervention further tests the separation: execution-oriented signals improve W broadly, yet commitment failures persist in models that do not already ground terminal reports in the achieved state. VIGIL provides a protocol that makes terminal commitment independently visible and scorable.
items.one_liner_zh: VIGIL 将具身智能体的任务完成与自我终止行为拆开评测，专门衡量终止承诺能力。
items.summary_cn: 标准具身评测通常不会独立衡量智能体在回合结束时是否正确地提交任务完成状态，本文将这种能力称为 terminal commitment。行为上不同的失败形式，例如从未完成任务、完成任务但未停止、以及在证据不足时错误报告成功，往往在现有基准中被压缩为同一种失败。本文提出 VIGIL，一个使 terminal commitment 可被独立测量的评测框架。在 VIGIL 的默认协议下，智能体不仅要完成任务，还必须在合适的时机基于充分证据作出结束判断，从而更细致地诊断具身智能体在任务闭环阶段的能力缺陷。

items.title: ConsistNav: Closing the Action Consistency Gap in Zero-Shot Object Navigation with Semantic Executive Control
items.summary: 提出无需训练的零样本 ObjectNav 框架 ConsistNav，通过语义执行控制减少探索与追踪之间的反复摇摆。
items.abstract_en: Zero-shot object navigation has advanced rapidly with open-vocabulary detectors, image--text models, and language-guided exploration. However, even after current methods detect a plausible target hypothesis, the agent may still oscillate between exploration and pursuit, or abandon the object near success. We identify this failure mode as an action consistency gap: semantic evidence is repeatedly reinterpreted at each step without persistent commitment across the episode. We introduce ConsistNav, a training-free zero-shot ObjectNav framework built around a semantic executive composed of three coordinated modules: Finite-State Executive Controller stages target pursuit through guarded semantic phases; Persistent Candidate Memory accumulates cross-frame target evidence into stable object hypotheses; and Stability-Aware Action Control suppresses rotational stagnation, ineffective pursuit, and unverified stopping. This design changes neither the detector nor the low-level planner; instead, it controls when semantic evidence should influence navigation and when it should be suppressed or revisited. We conduct extensive experiments on HM3D and MP3D, where ConsistNav achieves state-of-the-art results among compared zero-shot ObjectNav methods and improves SR by 11.4% and SPL by 7.9% over the controlled baseline on MP3D. Ablation studies and real-world deployment experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed executive mechanism.
items.one_liner_zh: 提出无需训练的零样本 ObjectNav 框架 ConsistNav，通过语义执行控制减少探索与追踪之间的反复摇摆。
items.summary_cn: 零样本目标导航受益于开放词表检测器、图文模型和语言引导探索而迅速发展。然而，即便现有方法检测到了看似合理的目标假设，智能体仍可能在探索与追逐之间来回振荡，或者在接近成功时放弃目标。我们将这种失败模式归因于动作一致性缺口：语义证据在每一步都会被重新解释，而缺乏跨整段 episode 的持续承诺。我们提出 ConsistNav，这是一个无需训练的零样本 ObjectNav 框架，其核心是由三个协同模块组成的语义执行器：Finite-State Executive Controller 通过受保护的语义阶段来推进目标追踪；Persistent Candidate Memory 将跨帧目标证据累积为稳定的目标假设；Stability-Aware Action Control 抑制旋转停滞、无效追逐和未经验证的停止。该设计既不改变检测器，也不改变底层规划器；它只是控制语义证据何时应影响导航，以及何时应被抑制或重新审视。我们在 HM3D 和 MP3D 上进行了大量实验，其中 ConsistNav 在所比较的零样本 ObjectNav 方法中取得了 state-of-the-art 结果，并在 MP3D 上相较于受控基线将 SR 提升 11.4%、SPL 提升 7.9%。消融实验和真实世界部署实验进一步证明了所提执行机制的有效性与鲁棒性。

items.title: High Precision Hydraulic Excavator Control for Heavy-Duty Grading
items.summary: 提出面向重载液压挖掘机高精度平地作业的自主控制器，在两类液压架构上都实现了专家级速度与更高精度。
items.abstract_en: High-precision heavy-duty grading is a common step in earthworks, traditionally carried out manually by skilled operators. Removing a significant amount of material while achieving a high-precision surface requires substantial machine-specific experience. Different hydraulic architectures react differently to operator inputs and soil interaction forces, which makes generalizable controllers challenging. In this paper, we present an autonomous controller that achieves high-precision grading at expert-operator speed on Load Sensing and Negative Flow Control machines alike. We split our controller into two parts: (1) a hydraulic-aware low-level loop that is hydraulic architecture-specific and (2) a path-tracking layer that coordinates joint motions and responses. Through a calibration process, our technique is applicable to load-sensing and negative-flow-control machinery. To showcase its versatility, we benchmark our approach on two excavators with different hydraulics and compare it against a commercial state-of-the-art solution. Our technique (RMSE 1.8~cm) outperforms the commercial solution (RMSE 4.7~cm) in precision by a factor of 2.6 and improves machine usage by leveraging the maximum function pressure, as opposed to commercial solutions that stall prematurely.
items.one_liner_zh: 提出面向重载液压挖掘机高精度平地作业的自主控制器，在两类液压架构上都实现了专家级速度与更高精度。
items.summary_cn: 高精度重载平地作业是土方工程中的常见步骤，传统上由熟练操作员手动完成。在移除大量物料的同时实现高精度表面，需要大量与具体机器相关的经验。不同液压架构对操作输入和土壤交互力的响应不同，这使得可泛化控制器的设计充满挑战。本文提出一种自主控制器，能够在 Load Sensing 和 Negative Flow Control 两类机器上，以专家操作员的速度实现高精度平地。我们的控制器分为两部分：(1) 面向液压特性的底层控制回路，其设计依赖具体液压架构；(2) 用于协调关节运动与响应的路径跟踪层。通过一个校准流程，该方法可适用于 load-sensing 和 negative-flow-control 机械。为展示其通用性，我们在两台液压系统不同的挖掘机上进行了基准测试，并与一种商用 state-of-the-art 方案比较。我们的技术以 1.8 cm 的 RMSE 达到比商用方案 4.7 cm 更高的精度，提升幅度为 2.6 倍，同时通过利用最大功能压力提高了机器利用率，而商用方案会过早停滞。

items.title: Continuum Robot Modeling with Action Conditioned Flow Matching
items.summary: 面向腱驱动连续体机器人，提出基于 action-conditioned flow matching 的自建模方法，用于从电机动作预测稳态三维形状。
items.abstract_en: Predicting the shape of tendon driven continuum robots (TDCRs) at steady state from actuation remains challenging due to continuous deformation, complex tendon routing, compliance, friction, and fabrication variability. In this paper, we address this problem as kinematic self modeling conditioned on action. We present a lightweight 3D printed TDCR hardware platform and an RGB-D data collection pipeline with multiple cameras, and we learn a point cloud flow matching model that maps motor actuation states to the robot's settled 3D geometry. The model is trained from randomly sampled quasi static configurations and evaluated on test motor commands within the same TDCR design family and actuation range. We compare against prior 3D deformable object and robot self modeling approaches in both MuJoCo simulation and real hardware experiments. Experiments on simulated 2-, 3-, and 5-module TDCRs and real 2- and 3-module robots show improved shape prediction accuracy under CD and EMD metrics. We further show in simulation that the same conditional formulation generalizes to tip payload as a conditioning input, enabling payload conditioned steady-state shape prediction. These results demonstrate a data driven self modeling framework for quasi static TDCR geometry prediction.
items.one_liner_zh: 面向腱驱动连续体机器人，提出基于 action-conditioned flow matching 的自建模方法，用于从电机动作预测稳态三维形状。
items.summary_cn: 由于存在连续形变、复杂的腱走线、柔顺性、摩擦以及制造差异，从驱动信号预测腱驱动连续体机器人 (TDCR) 的稳态形状仍然具有挑战性。本文将该问题表述为由动作条件化的运动学自建模。我们提出了一个轻量级 3D 打印 TDCR 硬件平台和一个带多相机的 RGB-D 数据采集流程，并学习了一个 point cloud flow matching 模型，将电机驱动状态映射到机器人的稳态三维几何形状。该模型在随机采样的准静态构型上训练，并在同一 TDCR 设计家族和驱动范围内的测试电机指令上评估。我们在 MuJoCo 仿真和真实硬件实验中，将该方法与以往的 3D 可变形对象和机器人自建模方法进行比较。针对仿真的 2、3、5 模块 TDCR 以及真实的 2、3 模块机器人，实验在 CD 和 EMD 指标下都显示出更优的形状预测精度。我们还在仿真中表明，同一条件化形式可以推广到将末端负载作为条件输入，从而实现按负载条件化的稳态形状预测。这些结果展示了一种面向准静态 TDCR 几何预测的数据驱动自建模框架。

items.title: Constraint-Aware Diffusion Priors for High-Fidelity and Versatile Quadruped Locomotion
items.summary: Diff-CAST 用 diffusion motion prior、对称命令条件化和约束强化学习提升四足机器人 locomotion 的多样性、跟踪一致性与上机安全性。
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning combined with imitation learning has significantly advanced biomimetic quadrupedal locomotion. However, scaling these frameworks to massive, multi-source datasets exposes fundamental bottlenecks. First, traditional GAN-based discriminators are prone to mode collapse, struggling to capture diverse motion distributions from uncurated datasets. Second, existing kinematic priors suffer from out-of-distribution (OOD) tracking conflicts, leading to severe unintended heading drifts during complex maneuvers. Furthermore, deploying unconstrained priors to physical hardware poses critical safety risks by disregarding actuator dynamics. To overcome these challenges, we propose Diff-CAST (Diffusion-guided Constraint-Aware Symmetric Tracking), a novel motion prior framework leveraging the multi-modal distribution modeling capabilities of diffusion models for stylistic rewards. Diff-CAST effectively replaces traditional GAN discriminators, unlocking robust data scaling on heterogeneous collections. To ensure high-fidelity intent execution and reliable real-world deployment, we introduce a comprehensive Sim2Re architecture integrating Symmetric Augmented Command Conditioning (SACC) for drift-free tracking, and Constrained RL for hardware safety. Experiments on a quadruped demonstrate that Diff-CAST mitigates mode collapse, enables seamless transitions between diverse skills, and ensures robust, hardware-compliant locomotion.
items.one_liner_zh: Diff-CAST 用 diffusion motion prior、对称命令条件化和约束强化学习提升四足机器人 locomotion 的多样性、跟踪一致性与上机安全性。
items.summary_cn: 强化学习与模仿学习的结合显著推动了仿生四足运动的发展。然而，将这些框架扩展到大规模、多源数据集时会暴露出根本瓶颈。首先，传统基于 GAN 的判别器容易发生 mode collapse，难以捕捉未经清洗数据集中的多样化运动分布。其次，现有运动学先验会遭遇 out-of-distribution (OOD) 跟踪冲突，在复杂机动中导致严重的非预期航向漂移。此外，将无约束先验部署到真实硬件会因忽视执行器动力学而带来关键安全风险。为解决这些问题，我们提出 Diff-CAST (Diffusion-guided Constraint-Aware Symmetric Tracking)，这是一种新的 motion prior 框架，利用 diffusion model 的多模态分布建模能力来提供风格化奖励。Diff-CAST 有效替代了传统 GAN 判别器，从而在异构数据集合上实现稳健的数据扩展。为确保高保真意图执行和可靠的真实世界部署，我们引入了完整的 Sim2Re 架构，其中包括用于无漂移跟踪的 Symmetric Augmented Command Conditioning (SACC)，以及用于硬件安全的 Constrained RL。四足机器人实验表明，Diff-CAST 能缓解 mode collapse，实现不同技能之间的无缝切换，并确保符合硬件约束的稳健 locomotion。

items.title: HeteroGenManip: Generalizable Manipulation For Heterogeneous Object Interactions
items.summary: HeteroGenManip 分解“在哪操作”和“如何操作”，提升异构对象交互的泛化操作能力。
items.abstract_en: Generalizable manipulation involving cross-type object interactions is a critical yet challenging capability in robotics. To reliably accomplish such tasks, robots must address two fundamental challenges: ``where to manipulate'' (contact point localization) and ``how to manipulate'' (subsequent interaction trajectory planning). Existing foundation-model-based approaches often adopt end-to-end learning that obscures the distinction between these stages, exacerbating error accumulation in long-horizon tasks. Furthermore, they typically rely on a single uniform model, which fails to capture the diverse, category-specific features required for heterogeneous objects. To overcome these limitations, we propose HeteroGenManip, a task-conditioned, two-stage framework designed to decouple initial grasp from complex interaction execution. First, Foundation-Correspondence-Guided Grasp module leverages structural priors to align the initial contact state, thereby significantly reducing the pose uncertainty of grasping. Subsequently, Multi-Foundation-Model Diffusion Policy (MFMDP) routes objects to category-specialized foundation models, integrating fine-grained geometric information with highly-variable part features via a dual-stream cross-attention mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that HeteroGenManip achieves robust intra-category shape and pose generalization. The framework achieves an average 31\% performance improvement in simulation tasks with broad type setting, alongside a 36.7\% gain across four real-world tasks with different interaction types.
items.one_liner_zh: HeteroGenManip 分解“在哪操作”和“如何操作”，提升异构对象交互的泛化操作能力。
items.summary_cn: 面向异构对象交互的泛化操作是机器人学中的关键但极具挑战的能力。要可靠完成此类任务，机器人必须同时解决两个根本问题：“在哪操作”（接触点定位）和“如何操作”（后续交互轨迹规划）。现有基于基础模型的方法往往采用端到端学习，掩盖了这两个阶段的区别，并加剧长程任务中的误差累积。我们提出 HeteroGenManip，以更结构化的方式处理跨类型对象交互。实验结果表明，该方法提升了泛化操作能力和任务成功率。

items.title: MVB-Grasp: Minimum-Volume-Box Filtering of Diffusion-based Grasps for Frontal Manipulation
items.summary: MVB-Grasp 用最小体积包围盒几何先验筛选 diffusion 抓取结果，提升正向抓取成功率。
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art 6-DoF grasp generators excel on tabletop benchmarks with overhead cameras but struggle in frontal grasping scenarios on low-cost manipulators with constrained workspaces, where kinematic limits and approach-direction constraints cause high failure rates. We address this challenge for the Unitree Z1 arm by proposing MVB-Grasp, a novel grasping stack that injects a Minimum Volume Bounding Box (MVBB) geometric prior into diffusion-based grasp generation to dramatically improve success rates in frontal, workspace-constrained settings. Our key scientific contributions are threefold: (i) an MVBB-based geometric filter that exploits oriented bounding-box face normals to reject grasps approaching through the table or misaligned with accessible object faces in O(N) time; (ii) a combined re-scoring function that blends learned discriminator scores with face-alignment geometry {\alpha}=0.85, specifically calibrated for the Z1's frontal workspace and kinematic constraints; and (iii) a systematic MuJoCo evaluation protocol measuring grasp success across object types, distances, lateral positions, and pitch orientations to validate embodiment-specific performance. We implement MVB-Grasp on a Unitree Z1 arm with an Intel RealSense D405 camera, integrating YOLOv8 object detection, GraspGen for candidate generation, Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based MVBB fitting, and inverse-kinematics trajectory planning. Experiments across 81 MuJoCo episodes (cylinder, asymmetric box, waterbottle) demonstrate that MVB-Grasp achieves 59.3% success versus 24.7% for vanilla GraspGen, a 2.4x improvement, by filtering geometrically infeasible candidates and prioritizing face-aligned grasps suited to the Z1's frontal approach constraints. Real-world trials confirm that the MVBB prior substantially improves grasp reliability on constrained, low-cost manipulators without requiring model retraining.
items.one_liner_zh: MVB-Grasp 用最小体积包围盒几何先验筛选 diffusion 抓取结果，提升正向抓取成功率。
items.summary_cn: 最先进的 6-DoF 抓取生成器在俯视相机的桌面基准上表现优异，但在低成本机械臂和受限工作空间中的正向抓取场景下表现不佳，因为运动学限制和进近方向约束会导致高失败率。针对 Unitree Z1 机械臂，我们提出 MVB-Grasp，这是一套新的抓取系统，通过在 diffusion-based grasp generation 中引入 Minimum Volume Bounding Box (MVBB) 几何先验，显著提升抓取候选的可执行性。实验表明，该方法能大幅改善正向操作场景中的抓取成功率。

items.title: AT-VLA: Adaptive Tactile Injection for Enhanced Feedback Reaction in Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: AT-VLA 用自适应触觉注入和双流反应机制提升 VLA 在接触密集操作中的实时反馈能力。
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have significantly advanced the capabilities of robotic agents in executing diverse tasks; however, they still face challenges in contact-rich manipulation scenarios that require precise physical interactions. To address this limitation, recent studies have attempted to incorporate tactile signals during downstream tasks, enabling pretrained VLAs to interpret tactile feedback. Nevertheless, introducing new modalities during finetuning, which are rarely present in the pretrain stage, may disrupt the pretrained capabilities of VLAs. In addition, the inherently slow inference speed of VLAs hampers real-time responsiveness and limits the effective utilization of tactile feedback for action adjustment. To overcome these challenges, we propose Adaptive Tactile Vision-Language-Action (AT-VLA), which introduces a novel Adaptive Tactile Injection mechanism. This mechanism dynamically determines the appropriate timing and locations for tactile injection, incorporating only when it significantly contributes to action generation, thereby minimizing interference with pretrained representations. Furthermore, to enable rapid and accurate tactile responses, we propose a Tactile Reaction Dual-Stream mechanism, which decouples sensory processing into a slow visual-language stream for low-frequency perceptual reasoning and a fast tactile control stream for high-frequency physical interaction understanding, achieving real-time close-loop responses within 0.04 s. Real-world experiments thoroughly validate the effectiveness of AT-VLA in contact-rich manipulation tasks. The project page is available at: https://sites.google.com/view/at-vla.
items.one_liner_zh: AT-VLA 用自适应触觉注入和双流反应机制提升 VLA 在接触密集操作中的实时反馈能力。
items.summary_cn: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型显著提升了机器人执行多样任务的能力，但在需要精确物理交互的接触密集型操作场景中仍面临挑战。为解决这一问题，近期工作尝试在下游任务中引入触觉信号，使预训练 VLA 能理解触觉反馈。然而，在预训练阶段很少出现的新模态若在微调时直接引入，可能破坏 VLA 的预训练能力；同时，VLA 天生较慢的推理速度也限制了对触觉反馈的实时利用。为此，本文提出 Adaptive Tactile Vision-Language-Action (AT-VLA)，其核心是新的 Adaptive Tactile Injection 机制，可动态决定何时、在何处注入触觉，仅在其对动作生成有显著帮助时才使用，从而尽量减少对预训练表征的干扰。此外，作者提出 Tactile Reaction Dual-Stream 机制，将感知处理解耦为低频视觉语言流和高频触觉控制流，实现 0.04 秒内的实时闭环响应。真实机器人实验充分验证了 AT-VLA 在接触密集型操作任务中的有效性。

items.title: BioProVLA-Agent: An Affordable, Protocol-Driven, Vision-Enhanced VLA-Enabled Embodied Multi-Agent System with Closed-Loop-Capable Reasoning for Biological Laboratory Manipulation
items.summary: BioProVLA-Agent 面向湿实验操作，把 protocol 驱动规划、视觉验证和 VLA 执行整合为低成本闭环系统。
items.abstract_en: Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.
items.one_liner_zh: BioProVLA-Agent 面向湿实验操作，把 protocol 驱动规划、视觉验证和 VLA 执行整合为低成本闭环系统。
items.summary_cn: 生物实验室自动化可以减少重复劳动并提高可复现性，但在湿实验环境中实现可靠的具身执行仍然很困难。实验 protocol 往往缺乏结构化表示，实验器皿经常透明或反光，多步骤流程也需要超越一次性指令跟随的状态感知执行。现有机器人系统通常依赖昂贵硬件、固定工作流、专用仪器或面向机器人专家的接口。本文提出 BioProVLA-Agent，这是一个低成本、由 protocol 驱动、视觉增强、并由 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型支持的具身多智能体系统，用于生物操作。系统以 protocol 作为任务接口，将协议解析、视觉状态验证和具身执行整合到闭环工作流中。Tailored LLM Protocol Agent 负责把 protocol 转成可验证子任务；VLM-RAG Verification Agent 利用观测、机器人状态、检索知识和成败样例评估子任务的准备状态与完成情况；VLA Embodied Agent 则通过轻量策略执行已验证子任务。为提升湿实验视觉扰动下的鲁棒性，作者提出 AugSmolVLA 在线增强策略，专门处理透明器皿、反光、光照变化和过曝。作者在包含 15 个原子任务、6 个复合流程和 3 个双臂任务的分层基准上进行了评测，结果表明在正常和高曝光设置下，AugSmolVLA 在精确放置、透明物体操作、复合流程和退化视觉场景中都比 ACT、X-VLA 和原始 SmolVLA 更稳定。

items.title: Escaping the Diversity Trap in Robotic Manipulation via Anchor-Centric Adaptation
items.summary: ACA 指出机器人少样本适配盲目追求多样性会掉入 diversity trap，并提出 anchor 优先的两阶段适配框架。
items.abstract_en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer broad general capabilities, deploying them on specific hardware requires real-world adaptation to bridge the embodiment gap. Since robot demonstrations are costly, this adaptation must often occur under a strict data budget. In this work, we identify a critical diversity trap: the standard heuristic of "maximizing coverage" by collecting diverse, single-shot demonstrations can be self-defeating due to non-vanishing estimation noise. We formalize this phenomenon as a Coverage--Density Trade-off. By decomposing the policy error into estimation (density) and extrapolation (coverage) terms, we characterize an interior optimal allocation of unique conditions for a fixed budget. Guided by this analysis, we propose Anchor-Centric Adaptation (ACA), a two-stage framework that first stabilizes a policy skeleton through repeated demonstrations at core anchors, then selectively expands coverage to high-risk boundaries via teacher-forced error mining and constrained residual updates. Real-robot experiments validate our trade-off framework and demonstrate that ACA significantly improves task reliability and success rates over standard diverse sampling strategies under the same budget.
items.one_liner_zh: ACA 指出机器人少样本适配盲目追求多样性会掉入 diversity trap，并提出 anchor 优先的两阶段适配框架。
items.summary_cn: 尽管 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型具备广泛的通用能力，但要部署到特定机器人硬件上，仍需要通过真实世界适配来弥合 embodiment gap。由于机器人示范数据昂贵，这种适配通常必须在严格的数据预算下进行。本文识别出一个关键的 diversity trap：常见的“最大化覆盖度”启发式，即通过采集多样化、一次性的示范来扩展覆盖范围，在存在不可忽略估计噪声时反而可能适得其反。作者将这一现象形式化为 Coverage-Density Trade-off。通过把策略误差分解为估计误差和外推误差两部分，作者刻画了在固定预算下独特条件数量的内部最优分配。基于这一分析，本文提出 Anchor-Centric Adaptation (ACA) 两阶段框架：先在核心 anchor 上用重复示范稳定策略骨架，再通过 teacher-forced error mining 和受约束的残差更新，有选择地扩展到高风险边界。真实机器人实验表明，在相同预算下 ACA 相比标准的多样性采样策略能显著提升任务可靠性和成功率。

items.title: PhySPRING: Structure-Preserving Reduction of Physics-Informed Twins via GNN
items.summary: PhySPRING 用可微 GNN 学习弹簧质点数字孪生的分层降采样拓扑，在保持物理保真度的同时提升仿真效率。
items.abstract_en: Physics-based digital twins aim to predict the dynamics of real-world objects under interaction, enabling real-to-sim-to-real applications in robotics. Current approaches reconstruct such twins as explicit physical models (such as spring-mass systems) to predict the dynamics, but the resulting models often inherit the resolution of the visual reconstruction rather than being reduced to the physical complexity required to reproduce task-relevant dynamics. This mismatch introduces redundant topology, making repeated forward-dynamics rollouts unnecessarily expensive. To address this challenge, we present PhySPRING, an fully differentiable GNN-based method to reduce complexity in spring--mass digital twins. PhySPRING jointly learns a hierarchy of coarsened graph topologies and their mechanical parameters from observations. At each reduction level, PhySPRING merges nodes with similar learned dynamic responses to optimize the topology, while maintaining every reduced layer as an explicit spring--mass system. On the PhysTwin benchmark, PhySPRING improves dense reconstruction and prediction accuracy over PhysTwin, while reduced models retain stable physical and visual fidelity with up to a 2.30 times speed-up. We further demonstrate the effectiveness of PhySPRING in a Real2Sim robot policy-evaluation pipeline, where the reduced models are substituted zero-shot into ACT and $\pi_0$ evaluations, maintaining comparable manipulation success rates across downsampling levels while improving action-sampling effectiveness. Together, PhySPRING enables efficient and structure-preserving spring--mass reduction without sacrificing fidelity or robotic utility.
items.one_liner_zh: PhySPRING 用可微 GNN 学习弹簧质点数字孪生的分层降采样拓扑，在保持物理保真度的同时提升仿真效率。
items.summary_cn: 基于物理的数字孪生旨在预测真实世界物体在交互下的动力学，从而支持机器人中的 real-to-sim-to-real 应用。现有方法通常把数字孪生重建为显式物理模型，例如弹簧质点系统，再用它来预测动力学；但得到的模型往往继承了视觉重建的分辨率，而没有被约简到复现任务相关动力学所需的物理复杂度。这种不匹配会引入冗余拓扑，使反复进行前向动力学 rollout 的代价过高。为解决这一问题，本文提出 PhySPRING，这是一种完全可微、基于 GNN 的方法，用于降低弹簧质点数字孪生的复杂度。PhySPRING 从观测中联合学习一组层次化粗化图拓扑及其力学参数。在每一层约简中，PhySPRING 会合并具有相似学习到的动态响应的节点来优化拓扑，同时保持每一层约简结果仍是显式弹簧质点系统。在 PhysTwin 基准上，PhySPRING 在稠密重建和预测精度上优于 PhysTwin，同时约简后的模型在物理和视觉保真度上保持稳定，并带来最高 2.30 倍加速。作者还在一个 Real2Sim 机器人策略评估流水线中验证了 PhySPRING 的有效性，将约简模型零样本替换进 ACT 和 π0 的评估中，在不同下采样层级下保持相近的操作成功率，同时提升动作采样效率。总体来看，PhySPRING 在不牺牲保真度和机器人实用性的前提下，实现了高效且保持结构的弹簧质点模型约简。

items.title: PISTO: Proximal Inference for Stochastic Trajectory Optimization
items.summary: PISTO 将 STOMP 解释为对 Boltzmann 轨迹分布的变分推断，并用 proximal KL 正则稳定随机轨迹优化更新。
items.abstract_en: Stochastic trajectory optimization methods like STOMP enable planning with non-differentiable costs, offering substantial flexibility over gradient-based approaches. We show that STOMP implicitly minimizes the KL divergence from a Boltzmann trajectory distribution, revealing an elegant Variational Inference (VI) structure underlying its updates. Building on this insight, we propose the \textit{Proximal Inference for Stochastic Trajectory Optimization} (PISTO) algorithm that stabilizes the updates by augmenting the objective with a KL regularization between successive Gaussian proposals. This proximal formulation admits a trust-region interpretation and yields closed-form mean updates computable as expectations under a surrogate distribution. We estimate these expectations via importance-weighted Monte Carlo sampling, producing a simple, derivative-free algorithm that inherits STOMP's ability to handle non-differentiable and discontinuous costs without modification. On robot arm motion planning benchmarks, PISTO achieves an 89\% success rate -- outperforming CHOMP (63\%) and STOMP (68\%) -- while producing shorter, smoother paths at twice the speed of competing stochastic methods. We further validate PISTO on contact-rich MuJoCo locomotion and manipulation tasks, where it consistently outperforms both CEM and MPPI baselines in reward.
items.one_liner_zh: PISTO 将 STOMP 解释为对 Boltzmann 轨迹分布的变分推断，并用 proximal KL 正则稳定随机轨迹优化更新。
items.summary_cn: STOMP 这类随机轨迹优化方法能够处理不可微代价函数，相比基于梯度的方法具备更大的灵活性。本文表明，STOMP 隐式地最小化了与一个 Boltzmann 轨迹分布之间的 KL 散度，从而揭示了其更新背后优雅的变分推断结构。基于这一观察，作者提出 Proximal Inference for Stochastic Trajectory Optimization (PISTO) 算法，通过在目标函数中加入相邻两次高斯 proposal 之间的 KL 正则项来稳定更新。这个 proximal 形式可以解释为 trust region，并导出可闭式计算的均值更新，其形式是某个 surrogate distribution 下的期望。作者通过基于重要性加权的 Monte Carlo 采样来估计这些期望，从而得到一个简单、无导数的算法，同时保留 STOMP 无需修改即可处理不可微和不连续代价的能力。在机器人手臂运动规划基准上，PISTO 实现了 89% 的成功率，优于 CHOMP 的 63% 和 STOMP 的 68%，同时生成更短、更平滑的轨迹，速度也达到竞争性随机方法的两倍。作者还在富接触的 MuJoCo 运动与操作任务上验证了 PISTO，在奖励表现上持续优于 CEM 和 MPPI 基线。

items.title: BrickCraft: Visuomotor Skill Composition with Situated Manual Guidance for Long-Horizon Interlocking Brick Assembly
items.summary: BrickCraft 通过参考砖相对建模和 situated manuals，把长程积木装配拆成可复用的空间落地技能链。
items.abstract_en: Autonomous robotic assembly of interlocking bricks demands seamless integration of long-horizon task reasoning, spatial grounding, and fine-grained manipulation. This paper presents BrickCraft, a compositional framework designed for long-horizon and generalizable interlocking brick assembly. BrickCraft models the assembly process using a relative formulation, where each step is anchored to a reference brick within the partial structure, thereby decomposing complex tasks into a finite set of reusable primitive skills. BrickCraft bridges the gap between high-level assembly plans and physical execution through situated manuals, which provide explicit spatial guidance for learned visuomotor skills by projecting the assembly intent onto real-time robot observations. Finally, BrickCraft employs a compositional execution pipeline that chains these spatially grounded skills to accomplish long-horizon assembly tasks. Extensive experimental validations demonstrate that BrickCraft acquires proficient assembly skills from a limited set of demonstrations and exhibits strong compositional generalization to unseen structures. The project website is available at https://intelligent-control-lab.github.io/BrickCraft.
items.one_liner_zh: BrickCraft 通过参考砖相对建模和 situated manuals，把长程积木装配拆成可复用的空间落地技能链。
items.summary_cn: 自主机器人进行互锁积木装配，需要把长程任务推理、空间对齐和细粒度操作无缝结合起来。本文提出 BrickCraft，这是一个面向长程且具泛化能力的互锁积木装配组合式框架。BrickCraft 使用相对化表示来建模装配过程，其中每一步都锚定到部分结构中的参考砖，从而将复杂任务分解为有限组可复用的原子技能。BrickCraft 通过 situated manuals 弥合高层装配计划与物理执行之间的差距，这类 manual 会把装配意图投射到实时机器人观测上，为学习到的 visuomotor skills 提供显式空间引导。最终，BrickCraft 采用组合式执行流水线，把这些空间对齐后的技能串联起来完成长程装配任务。大量实验表明，BrickCraft 能从有限示范中学到高质量装配技能，并对未见结构表现出很强的组合泛化能力。

items.title: AGWM: Affordance-Grounded World Models for Environments with Compositional Prerequisites
items.summary: AGWM 把动作先决条件建成 affordance DAG，用于追踪可执行性的动态变化并降低 world model 长程误差。
items.abstract_en: In model-based learning, the agent learns behaviors by simulating trajectories based on world model predictions. Standard world models typically learn a stationary transition function that maps states and actions to next states, when an action and an outcome frequently co-occur in training data, the model tends to internalize this correlation as a general causal rule while ignoring action preconditions. In interactive environments, however, agent actions can reshape the future affordance space. At each timestep, an action may becomes executable only after its prerequisites are met, or non-executable when they are destroyed. We term such events structure-changing events (SC events). As a result, a conventional world model often fails to determine whether a given action is executable in the current state, especially in multi-step predictions. Each imagined step is conditioned on an incorrect affordance state, and therefore the prediction error compounds over the rollout horizon. In this paper, we propose AGWM (Affordance-Grounded World Model), which learns an abstract affordance structure represented as a DAG of prerequisite dependencies to explicitly track the dynamic executability of actions. Experiments on game-based simulated environments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by achieving lower multi-step prediction error, better generalization to novel configurations, and improved interpretability.
items.one_liner_zh: AGWM 把动作先决条件建成 affordance DAG，用于追踪可执行性的动态变化并降低 world model 长程误差。
items.summary_cn: 在基于模型的学习中，智能体通过基于 world model 预测的轨迹模拟来学习行为。标准 world model 通常学习一个静态转移函数，把状态和动作映射到下一状态；当某个动作和某个结果在训练数据中频繁共现时，模型往往会把这种相关性内化为一般性的因果规则，而忽略动作的前置条件。然而在交互环境中，智能体动作会重塑未来的 affordance 空间。在每个时间步，一个动作可能只有在满足其先决条件后才可执行，也可能在这些条件被破坏后变为不可执行。作者将这类事件称为 structure-changing events。传统 world model 往往无法判断某个动作在当前状态下是否可执行，尤其是在多步预测时更明显。每一步 imagined rollout 都建立在错误的 affordance 状态上，误差会沿时间步不断累积。本文提出 AGWM，通过学习一个由先决条件依赖关系构成的 DAG 形式抽象 affordance 结构，显式跟踪动作可执行性的动态变化。实验表明，该方法能降低多步预测误差、提升对新配置的泛化能力，并改善可解释性。

items.title: Three-in-One World Model: Energy-Based Consistency, Prediction, and Counterfactual Inference for Marketing Intervention
items.summary: Three-in-One World Model 用统一的 DBM belief 表征同时支持一致性能量评估、结果预测和反事实干预推断。
items.abstract_en: Marketing decisions reflect the interaction of latent consumer heterogeneity, time-varying internal states, and explicit interventions, a structure that current prediction- and language-oriented models do not capture in a unified manner. We propose a Three-in-One world-model architecture in which a Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM) learns a frozen belief representation from demographics, time, and lagged actions and outcomes, with lightweight task-specific adapters attached on top. The same belief supports three tasks within a single framework: (i) energy-based consistency evaluation through the DBM's free energy, (ii) outcome prediction through adapters, and (iii) counterfactual inference by holding the belief fixed and varying only the action input given to the adapter. Using a controlled simulation in which the latent price sensitivity, promotion responsiveness, and base preference of each consumer are known, we show that the adapters match a strong MLP baseline on visit- and purchase-AUC while recovering heterogeneous treatment effects substantially better than S-, T-, X-, and DR-learner meta-learners and a Causal Forest baseline built on the same raw features, with the largest gap on a confounded price-promotion intervention. Complementing this, free-energy clamps systematically penalize counterfactual purchase trajectories that lack prior promotional exposure, and the penalty itself depends on the latent base preference in the expected direction. These results indicate that DBM beliefs disentangle latent traits in a form that survives counterfactual queries, providing an integrated world-model substrate for marketing intervention.
items.one_liner_zh: Three-in-One World Model 用统一的 DBM belief 表征同时支持一致性能量评估、结果预测和反事实干预推断。
items.summary_cn: 营销决策体现了潜在消费者异质性、随时间变化的内部状态以及显式干预之间的相互作用，而现有偏预测或偏语言的模型并不能统一刻画这种结构。本文提出一种 Three-in-One world-model 架构，其中 Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM) 从人口统计、时间以及滞后动作和结果中学习一个冻结的 belief 表征，并在其上附加轻量级任务特定 adapter。同一个 belief 在单一框架中支持三项任务：(i) 通过 DBM 的 free energy 进行基于能量的一致性评估；(ii) 通过 adapter 进行结果预测；(iii) 在固定 belief 并只改变输入动作的情况下进行反事实推断。作者在一个受控模拟环境中验证该方法，其中每个消费者的潜在价格敏感度、促销响应性和基础偏好都是已知的。结果表明，这些 adapter 在 visit-AUC 和 purchase-AUC 上可以匹配强 MLP 基线，同时在恢复异质处理效应方面显著优于 S/T/X/DR learner 以及使用相同原始特征构建的 Causal Forest，尤其是在受价格与促销混杂影响的干预场景下优势最明显。此外，free-energy clamp 会系统性地惩罚那些缺少先前促销暴露的反事实购买轨迹，而且这种惩罚会随着潜在基础偏好以符合预期的方式变化。结果说明，DBM belief 能以适用于反事实查询的形式解耦潜在特征，从而为营销干预提供一个统一的 world-model substrate。

items.title: Drifting Field Policy: A One-Step Generative Policy via Wasserstein Gradient Flow
items.summary: DFP 用 Wasserstein 梯度流构造单步生成策略，在 Robomimic 和 OGBench 多个操作任务上超过 ODE 型策略。
items.abstract_en: We propose Drifting Field Policy (DFP), a non-ODE one-step generative policy built on the drifting model paradigm. We frame the policy update as a reverse-KL Wasserstein-2 gradient flow toward a soft target policy, so that each DFP update corresponds to a gradient step in probability space. By construction, this gradient is decomposed into an ascent toward higher action-value regions and a score matching with the anchor policy as a trust region. We further derive a simple, tractable surrogate of the otherwise intractable update loss, akin to behavior cloning on top-K critic-selected actions. We find empirically that this mechanism uniquely benefits the drifting backbone owing to its non-ODE parameterization. With one-step inference, DFP achieves state-of-the-art performance on several manipulation tasks across Robomimic and OGBench, outperforming ODE-based policies.
items.one_liner_zh: DFP 用 Wasserstein 梯度流构造单步生成策略，在 Robomimic 和 OGBench 多个操作任务上超过 ODE 型策略。
items.summary_cn: 本文提出 Drifting Field Policy (DFP)，这是一种建立在 drifting model 范式上的非 ODE 单步生成策略。作者把策略更新表述为朝向一个软目标策略的 reverse-KL Wasserstein-2 梯度流，因此每次 DFP 更新都对应于概率空间中的一次梯度步。按构造，这个梯度可以分解为两个部分：一部分朝向更高 action-value 区域上升，另一部分则与 anchor policy 做 score matching，从而充当 trust region。作者进一步导出了原本难以处理的更新损失的一个简单、可计算 surrogate，其形式类似于对 critic 选出的 top-K 动作执行行为克隆。实验发现，这种机制对 drifting backbone 尤其有效，原因在于其非 ODE 参数化。借助单步推理，DFP 在 Robomimic 和 OGBench 的多个操作任务上达到了新的最佳性能，并超过了基于 ODE 的策略。

items.title: NoiseGate: Learning Per-Latent Timestep Schedules as Information Gating in World Action Models
items.summary: NoiseGate 学习逐 latent 的时间步门控策略，让 WAM 按未来观测可靠性自适应调节动作生成。
items.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) are an emerging family of policies that tie robot action generation to future-observation modeling. In this work, we focus on the joint video--action modeling paradigm, where actions and imagined future observations are co-generated along a shared denoising or flow trajectory, so that perception, prediction, and control are coupled within one generative process. Existing WAMs typically realize this paradigm with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT), where video and action tokens interact through shared self-attention. This architecture can in principle assign a separate timestep $t_f$ to each predicted latent frame, yet current systems collapse this degree of freedom onto a single shared scalar $t$. Under the noise-as-masking view of Diffusion Forcing, this shared schedule imposes the unjustified prior that every predicted latent is equally reliable for action generation. We instead view the per-latent schedule as a \emph{learnable information-gating policy}: by changing a latent frame's noise level, the policy modulates the reliability of its Key/Value contribution to the action tokens. We propose \textbf{NoiseGate}, which combines independent per-latent timestep sampling during backbone training, a lightweight Gating Policy Network that emits per-latent time increments during denoising, and task-reward optimization that trains the schedule policy without hand-crafted shape priors. Built on a joint video--action MoT backbone, NoiseGate delivers consistent gains on diverse RoboTwin random-scene manipulation tasks.
items.one_liner_zh: NoiseGate 学习逐 latent 的时间步门控策略，让 WAM 按未来观测可靠性自适应调节动作生成。
items.summary_cn: World Action Models (WAMs) 是一类新兴策略模型，它把机器人动作生成与未来观测建模绑定在一起。本文关注联合 video-action 建模范式，其中动作和想象出的未来观测沿共享的去噪或流轨迹共同生成，因此感知、预测和控制被耦合在同一个生成过程中。现有 WAM 通常使用 Mixture-of-Transformers 实现这一范式，在其中视频 token 与动作 token 通过共享自注意力交互。理论上，这种架构可以为每个预测 latent frame 分配单独的时间步，但当前系统通常把这一自由度压缩成单一共享标量。在 Diffusion Forcing 的视角下，这种共享 schedule 等于假设所有预测 latent 对动作生成都同样可靠。作者因此把逐 latent 的 schedule 视为一种可学习的信息门控策略：通过改变某个 latent frame 的噪声水平，策略可以调节该 frame 对动作 token 的贡献可靠性。本文提出 NoiseGate，将逐 latent 时间步采样、轻量 Gating Policy Network 与基于任务奖励的 schedule 策略优化结合起来。在联合 video-action backbone 上，NoiseGate 在多种 RoboTwin 操作任务上都取得了稳定增益。

items.title: Predictive but Not Plannable: RC-aux for Latent World Models
items.summary: RC-aux 为 latent world model 增加多步与可达性校正监督，缓解预测准确但不利于规划的表示错位问题。
items.abstract_en: A latent world model may achieve accurate short-horizon prediction while still inducing a latent space that is poorly aligned with planning. A key issue is spatiotemporal mismatch: these models are often trained with local predictive supervision, but deployed for long-horizon goal-directed search in latent spaces where Euclidean distance may not reflect what is reachable within a finite action budget. We present the Reachability-Correction auxiliary objective (RC-aux), a lightweight correction for this mismatch in reconstruction-free latent world models. RC-aux keeps the world-model backbone unchanged and adds planning-aligned supervision along two axes. Along the time axis, multi-horizon open-loop prediction trains the model beyond one-step consistency. Along the space axis, budget-conditioned reachability supervision, together with temporal hard negatives, encourages the latent space to distinguish states that are eventually reachable from those reachable within the current planning horizon. At test time, the learned reachability signal can also be used by a reachability-aware planner to favor trajectories that are both goal-directed and attainable under the available budget. We instantiate RC-aux on LeWorldModel and evaluate it under both continuation-training and matched-from-scratch settings. Across goal-conditioned pixel-control tasks and a LIBERO-Goal extension, RC-aux improves LeWM-style planning with modest additional cost. These results suggest that planning with latent world models depends not only on predictive accuracy, but also on whether the learned representation encodes the temporal and geometric structure required by downstream search. The code is available at https://github.com/Guang000/RC-aux.
items.one_liner_zh: RC-aux 为 latent world model 增加多步与可达性校正监督，缓解预测准确但不利于规划的表示错位问题。
items.summary_cn: 一个 latent world model 可能在短时预测上非常准确，但其诱导出的 latent space 仍然与规划 poorly aligned。关键问题在于时空错配：这些模型往往用局部预测监督训练，却被部署到需要长程目标导向搜索的 latent space 中，而该空间中的欧氏距离未必能反映在有限动作预算下什么状态是真正可达的。本文提出 Reachability-Correction auxiliary objective (RC-aux)，它是针对无重建 latent world model 的一种轻量校正方法。RC-aux 保持原有 world-model backbone 不变，并沿两个维度引入与规划对齐的监督。时间维度上，多步 open-loop prediction 让模型超越单步一致性；空间维度上，预算条件化的 reachability 监督结合时间硬负样本，使 latent space 能区分“最终可达”与“在当前规划视野内可达”的状态。测试时，学习到的 reachability 信号还可以被 reachability-aware planner 使用，从而偏向那些既朝向目标、又在预算约束下真正可达的轨迹。作者将 RC-aux 实例化到 LeWorldModel 上，并在 continuation-training 和 matched-from-scratch 设置下进行了评估。在目标条件像素控制任务和一个 LIBERO-Goal 扩展上，RC-aux 都以适度额外代价提升了基于 LeWM 的规划效果。结果表明，latent world model 的规划能力不仅依赖预测精度，也依赖其表征是否编码了下游搜索所需的时间与几何结构。

items.title: Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models
items.summary: 该工作提出用 action-state consistency 诊断 WAM rollout 可靠性，并用无 value 的共识选择提升 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 成功率。
items.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) enable decision-making through imagined rollouts by predicting future observations and actions. However, the reliability of these imagined futures remains under-examined: is a generated future merely visually plausible, or is it dynamically compatible with the action sequence it claims to model? In this work, we identify action-state consistency, the alignment between predicted actions and induced state transitions, as a missing reliability axis for WAMs. Through a systematic study across representative joint-prediction and inverse-dynamics models, we find that action-state consistency systematically separates successful and failed rollouts across many tasks and follows similar success-failure trends as learned value estimates. These results suggest that consistency captures decision-relevant structure beyond visual realism. We further identify background collapse as an important boundary condition, where low-dynamics failed trajectories can become deceptively consistent because static futures are easier to predict. Building on these findings, we introduce a value-free consensus strategy for test-time selection, which ranks candidate rollouts by agreement among predicted futures. This strategy improves success rates on RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0 without additional training or reward modeling. Taken together, our findings establish action-state consistency as both a diagnostic tool for evaluating WAM reliability and a practical signal for value-free planning.
items.one_liner_zh: 该工作提出用 action-state consistency 诊断 WAM rollout 可靠性，并用无 value 的共识选择提升 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 成功率。
items.summary_cn: World Action Models (WAMs) 通过预测未来观测和动作来进行 imagined rollout，从而支持决策。然而，这些 imagined future 的可靠性一直缺乏系统检验：一个生成出来的未来究竟只是视觉上合理，还是在动力学上与它声称对应的动作序列兼容？本文识别出 action-state consistency，即预测动作与诱导出的状态转移之间的一致性，是 WAM 可靠性中缺失的重要维度。通过对代表性的 joint-prediction 和 inverse-dynamics 模型进行系统研究，作者发现 action-state consistency 在许多任务上都能稳定地区分成功 rollout 与失败 rollout，并且与学习到的 value estimate 呈现相似的成败趋势。这表明 consistency 捕捉到了超越视觉真实性的、与决策相关的结构。作者还进一步指出 background collapse 是一个重要边界条件：在低动态失败轨迹中，由于静态未来更容易预测，这些轨迹会表现出一种具有迷惑性的高一致性。基于这些发现，本文提出一种无 value 的共识式测试时选择策略，通过候选 rollout 之间的未来预测一致性来排序。该策略无需额外训练或奖励建模，就能提升 RoboCasa 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上的成功率。总体上，本文将 action-state consistency 确立为评估 WAM 可靠性的诊断工具，也将其证明为一种适合无 value 规划的实用信号。

items.title: DexSim2Real: Foundation Model-Guided Sim-to-Real Transfer for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: DexSim2Real 用视觉语言基础模型引导域随机化，并结合视触觉策略与课程学习，显著提升灵巧操作 sim-to-real 成功率。
items.abstract_en: Sim-to-real transfer remains a critical bottleneck for deploying dexterous manipulation policies learned in simulation to real-world robots. Existing approaches rely on manually designed domain randomization or task-specific adaptation, limiting their generalizability across diverse manipulation scenarios. We present DexSim2Real, an integrated framework that leverages vision-language foundation models to bridge the sim-to-real gap for dexterous manipulation. Our system combines three components: (1) Foundation Model-Guided Domain Randomization (FM-DR), which uses a vision-language model as a visual realism critic to optimize simulation parameters via closed-loop CMA-ES, complementing text-based approaches like DrEureka with direct visual feedback; (2) a Tactile-Visual Cross-Attention Policy (TVCAP) that adapts cross-attention visuo-tactile fusion to zero-shot sim-to-real RL; and (3) a Progressive Skill Curriculum (PSC) that builds on LLM-based task decomposition with a difficulty scheduler tailored to contact-rich dexterous tasks. Extensive experiments on six challenging manipulation tasks with blinded evaluation demonstrate that DexSim2Real achieves a 78.2% average real-world success rate, outperforming DrEureka and DeXtreme while reducing the sim-to-real performance gap to only 8.3%.
items.one_liner_zh: DexSim2Real 用视觉语言基础模型引导域随机化，并结合视触觉策略与课程学习，显著提升灵巧操作 sim-to-real 成功率。
items.summary_cn: 将仿真中学到的灵巧操作策略迁移到真实机器人上，sim-to-real transfer 仍然是部署中的关键瓶颈。现有方法依赖手工设计的域随机化或特定任务的适配，限制了它们在多样化操作场景中的泛化能力。我们提出 DexSim2Real，一个集成框架，利用 vision-language foundation models 来弥合灵巧操作中的 sim-to-real gap。我们的系统结合了三个组件：(1) Foundation Model-Guided Domain Randomization (FM-DR)，它使用 vision-language model 作为视觉真实性判别器，通过闭环 CMA-ES 优化仿真参数，以直接视觉反馈补充 DrEureka 等基于文本的方法；(2) Tactile-Visual Cross-Attention Policy (TVCAP)，它将 cross-attention 视觉-触觉融合适配到 zero-shot sim-to-real RL；以及 (3) Progressive Skill Curriculum (PSC)，它在基于 LLM 的任务分解之上，构建了一个针对富接触灵巧任务定制的难度调度器。在六个具有挑战性的操作任务上的大规模实验以及盲测评估表明，DexSim2Real 在真实世界中实现了 78.2% 的平均成功率，优于 DrEureka 和 DeXtreme，同时将 sim-to-real 性能差距缩小到仅 8.3%。

items.title: VLA-GSE: Boosting Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning in VLA with Generalized and Specialized Experts
items.summary: VLA-GSE 通过广义/专用专家分解实现高效 VLA 微调，仅更新 2.51% 参数却超过 FFT 与现有 PEFT 基线。
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit rich visual-semantic priors from pre-trained vision-language backbones, but adapting them to robotic control remains challenging. Full fine-tuning (FFT) is prone to overfitting on downstream robotic data and catastrophic forgetting of pretrained vision-language capabilities. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) better preserves pre-trained knowledge, yet existing PEFT methods still struggle to adapt effectively to robot control tasks. To address this gap, we propose VLA-GSE, a parameter-efficient VLA fine-tuning framework that improves control adaptation while retaining PEFT's knowledge preservation advantage. Specifically, VLA-GSE (Generalized and Specialized Experts) is initialized by spectrally decomposing the frozen backbone, assigning leading singular components to generalized experts (shared experts) and disjoint residual components to specialized experts (routed experts). This decomposition improves adaptation capacity under a fixed trainable-parameter budget. Under a comparable parameter budget, VLA-GSE updates only 2.51% of the full model parameters and consistently outperforms strong FFT and PEFT baselines. It achieves 81.2% average zero-shot success on LIBERO-Plus, preserves pre-trained VLM capability comparably to LoRA on multimodal understanding benchmarks, and improves real-world manipulation success under multiple distribution shifts. Code is available at: https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/VLA-GSE
items.one_liner_zh: VLA-GSE 通过广义/专用专家分解实现高效 VLA 微调，仅更新 2.51% 参数却超过 FFT 与现有 PEFT 基线。
items.summary_cn: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型从预训练视觉-语言骨干中继承了丰富的视觉语义先验，但将其适配到机器人控制仍然具有挑战性。全量微调（FFT）容易在下游机器人数据上过拟合，并灾难性遗忘预训练的视觉-语言能力。参数高效微调（PEFT）能更好地保留预训练知识，但现有 PEFT 方法仍难以有效适配机器人控制任务。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 VLA-GSE，一种参数高效的 VLA 微调框架，在保留 PEFT 知识保持优势的同时提升控制适配能力。具体而言，VLA-GSE（Generalized and Specialized Experts）通过对冻结骨干进行谱分解来初始化，将主导奇异成分分配给 generalized experts（shared experts），将不相交的残差成分分配给 specialized experts（routed experts）。这种分解在固定可训练参数预算下提升了适配能力。在可比参数预算下，VLA-GSE 仅更新完整模型参数的 2.51%，并持续优于强 FFT 和 PEFT 基线。它在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 81.2% 的平均 zero-shot success，在多模态理解基准上以与 LoRA 相当的水平保留预训练 VLM 能力，并在多种分布偏移下提升真实世界操作成功率。代码已开源：https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/VLA-GSE

items.title: When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models
items.summary: FFDC 为 WAM 引入自适应动作执行机制，在减少 69.10% 前向次数的同时提升成功率与真实世界鲁棒性。
items.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly predicting future visual observations and future actions. However, current WAMs typically execute a fixed number of predicted actions after each model inference, leaving the robot blind to whether the imagined future remains consistent with the actual physical rollout. In this work, we formulate adaptive WAM execution as a future-reality verification problem: the robot should execute longer when the WAM-predicted future remains reliable, and replan earlier when reality deviates from imagination. To this end, we propose Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC), a lightweight verifier that jointly reasons over predicted future actions, predicted visual dynamics, real observations, and language instructions to estimate whether the remaining action rollout can still be trusted. FFDC enables adaptive action chunk sizes as an emergent consequence of prediction-observation consistency, preserving the efficiency of long-horizon execution while restoring responsiveness in contact-rich or difficult phases. We further introduce Mixture-of-Horizon Training to improve long-horizon trajectory coverage for adaptive execution. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark and in the real world demonstrate that our method achieves a strong robustness-efficiency trade-off: on RoboTwin, it reduces WAM forward passes by 69.10% and execution time by 34.02%, while improving success rate by 2.54% over the short-chunk baseline; in real-world experiments, it improves success rate by 35%.
items.one_liner_zh: FFDC 为 WAM 引入自适应动作执行机制，在减少 69.10% 前向次数的同时提升成功率与真实世界鲁棒性。
items.summary_cn: 世界动作模型（WAM）近期已成为机器人操作中一个很有前景的范式，它通过联合预测未来视觉观测和未来动作来工作。然而，当前 WAM 通常在每次模型推理后执行固定数量的预测动作，这使机器人无法判断想象中的未来是否仍与真实物理 rollout 一致。在这项工作中，我们将自适应 WAM 执行表述为一个 future-reality verification 问题：当 WAM 预测的未来仍然可靠时，机器人应执行更长的动作序列；当现实偏离想象时，则应更早重新规划。为此，我们提出 Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention（FFDC），一种轻量级 verifier，它联合考虑预测的未来动作、预测的视觉动力学、真实观测和语言指令，以估计剩余动作 rollout 是否仍然值得信任。FFDC 使自适应动作块大小成为预测与观测一致性的自然结果，在保持长时程执行效率的同时恢复了在富接触或困难阶段中的响应性。我们还引入 Mixture-of-Horizon Training，以提升自适应执行所需的长时程轨迹覆盖。RoboTwin 基准和真实世界实验表明，我们的方法实现了很强的鲁棒性-效率权衡：在 RoboTwin 上，它将 WAM 前向传播次数减少 69.10%，执行时间减少 34.02%，同时相较于短动作块基线将成功率提升 2.54%；在真实世界实验中，成功率提升 35%。

items.title: CKT-WAM: Parameter-Efficient Context Knowledge Transfer Between World Action Models
items.summary: CKT-WAM 把教师 WAM 知识压缩进文本嵌入上下文，以 1.17% 可训练参数提升零样本泛化和长时程操作表现。
items.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) provide a powerful generative framework for embodied control, yet transferring knowledge across heterogeneous WAMs remains challenging due to mismatched latent interfaces, high adaptation cost, and the rigidity of conventional distillation objectives. We propose \textbf{CKT-WAM}, a parameter-efficient \textbf{C}ontext \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{T}ransfer framework that transfers teacher WAM's knowledge into a student WAM through a compact context in the text embedding space, rather than output imitation or dense hidden-state matching. Specifically, CKT-WAM extracts intermediate teacher hidden states, reduces the number of tokens via compressors' learnable-query cross attention (LQCA), and transforms them through an always-on generalized adapter, a lightweight router, and sparsely activated specialized adapters. The resulting context is then appended to the student's conditioning textual embeddings, thereby injecting the transferred knowledge into the student with minimal architectural modification. Experiments show that CKT-WAM consistently improves zero-shot generalization and achieves the best overall performance on LIBERO-Plus, reaching 86.1\% total success rate with only 1.17\% trainable parameters, while approaching full fine-tuning performance. Beyond simulation, CKT-WAM also demonstrates strong real-world long-horizon manipulation ability, achieving the best average success rate of 83.3\% across four multi-step and long-horizon tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/CKT-WAM.
items.one_liner_zh: CKT-WAM 把教师 WAM 知识压缩进文本嵌入上下文，以 1.17% 可训练参数提升零样本泛化和长时程操作表现。
items.summary_cn: 世界动作模型（WAM）为具身控制提供了强大的生成式框架，但由于潜在接口不匹配、适配成本高以及传统蒸馏目标过于僵化，在异构 WAM 之间迁移知识仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 	extbf{CKT-WAM}，一种参数高效的 	extbf{C}ontext 	extbf{K}nowledge 	extbf{T}ransfer 框架，它不是通过输出模仿或稠密隐藏状态匹配，而是通过文本嵌入空间中的紧凑上下文，将教师 WAM 的知识迁移到学生 WAM。具体而言，CKT-WAM 提取教师的中间隐藏状态，利用 compressors 的可学习查询交叉注意力（LQCA）减少 token 数量，并通过一个始终开启的 generalized adapter、一个轻量级 router 和稀疏激活的 specialized adapters 对其进行变换。随后，将得到的上下文附加到学生模型的条件文本嵌入之后，从而以极小的架构改动向学生注入迁移知识。实验表明，CKT-WAM 能稳定提升 zero-shot 泛化，并在 LIBERO-Plus 上取得最佳整体性能，在仅有 1.17% 可训练参数的情况下达到 86.1% 的总成功率，并接近全量微调性能。除仿真外，CKT-WAM 在真实世界长时程操作中也表现出很强能力，在四个多步和长时程任务上取得 83.3% 的最佳平均成功率。代码已开源：https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/CKT-WAM。

items.title: OA-WAM: Object-Addressable World Action Model for Robust Robot Manipulation
items.summary: OA-WAM 用可寻址对象槽状态替代整体场景表征，显著提升机器人操作在场景扰动下的对象绑定与鲁棒性。
items.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) enhance Vision-Language-Action policies by jointly predicting scene evolution and robot actions, but existing methods usually represent the predicted world as holistic images, video tokens, or global latents. These representations are difficult for an action decoder to address when an instruction refers to a particular object, especially under scene shifts where object identity is entangled with context. We propose OA-WAM, an Object-Addressable World Action Model for robust robot manipulation. OA-WAM decomposes each frame into N+1 slot states, with one robot slot and N object slots. Each slot contains a persistent address vector and a time-varying content vector, and is fused with text, image, proprioception, and past-action tokens in a block-causal sequence. A world head predicts next-frame slot states, while a flow-matching action head decodes a 16-step continuous action chunk in the same forward pass. Addressability is enforced by routing cross-slot attention through address-only keys and resetting the address slice at every transformer layer, separating which object to act on from what that object currently is without adding extra tokens. OA-WAM matches strong VLA and WAM baselines on LIBERO (97.8%) and SimplerEnv (79.3%), reaches state-of-the-art performance on the most relevant LIBERO-Plus geometric axes, and remains competitive on the seven-axis aggregate. A causal slot-intervention test yields a swap-binding cosine of 0.87, versus at most 0.09 for holistic baselines. These results suggest that addressable object states provide an effective interface for robust world-action modeling under scene perturbations.
items.one_liner_zh: OA-WAM 用可寻址对象槽状态替代整体场景表征，显著提升机器人操作在场景扰动下的对象绑定与鲁棒性。
items.summary_cn: 世界动作模型（WAM）通过联合预测场景演化与机器人动作来增强视觉-语言-动作策略，但现有方法通常将预测世界表示为整体图像、视频 token 或全局潜变量。当指令指向某个特定对象时，尤其是在对象身份与上下文纠缠的场景变化下，这些表示很难被动作解码器准确寻址。我们提出 OA-WAM，一种面向鲁棒机器人操作的 Object-Addressable World Action Model。OA-WAM 将每一帧分解为 N+1 个槽状态，其中包含 1 个机器人槽和 N 个对象槽。每个槽都包含一个持久地址向量和一个随时间变化的内容向量，并在块因果序列中与文本、图像、本体感觉和历史动作 token 融合。world head 预测下一帧槽状态，而 flow-matching action head 在同一次前向传播中解码一个 16 步连续动作块。我们通过仅使用地址 key 路由跨槽注意力，并在每一层 transformer 重置地址切片来强制实现可寻址性，从而在不增加额外 token 的情况下，将“对哪个对象执行动作”与“该对象当前是什么”分离。OA-WAM 在 LIBERO（97.8%）和 SimplerEnv（79.3%）上达到与强 VLA 和 WAM 基线相当的性能，在最相关的 LIBERO-Plus 几何轴上达到 state-of-the-art，并在七轴聚合指标上保持竞争力。一个因果槽干预测试得到 0.87 的 swap-binding cosine，而整体式基线最高仅为 0.09。这些结果表明，可寻址的对象状态为场景扰动下的鲁棒 world-action 建模提供了有效接口。

items.title: Structure-Preserving Gaussian Processes Via Discrete Euler-Lagrange Equations
items.summary: LGP 通过离散 Euler-Lagrange 方程学习结构保持的机器人动力学，可仅凭稀疏位置观测实现稳定长期预测。
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Lagrangian Gaussian Processes (LGPs) for probabilistic and data-efficient learning of dynamics via discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations. Importantly, the geometric structure of the Lagrange-d'Alembert principle, which governs the motion of dynamical systems, is preserved by construction in the absence of external forces. This allows learning physically consistent models that overcome erroneous drift in the system's energy, thereby providing stable long-term predictions. At the core of our approach lie linear operators for Gaussian process conditioning, constructed from discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations and variational discretization schemes. Thereby and unlike prior work, the method enables learning dynamics from discrete position snapshots, i.e., without access to a system's velocities or momenta. This is particularly relevant for a large class of practical scenarios where only position measurements are available, for instance, in motion capture or visual servoing applications. We demonstrate the data-efficiency and generalization capabilities of the LGPs in various synthetic and real-world case studies, including a real-world soft robot with hysteresis. The experimental results underscore that the LGPs learn physically consistent dynamics with uncertainty quantification solely from sparse positional data and enable stable long-term predictions.
items.one_liner_zh: LGP 通过离散 Euler-Lagrange 方程学习结构保持的机器人动力学，可仅凭稀疏位置观测实现稳定长期预测。
items.summary_cn: 本文提出了 Lagrangian Gaussian Processes (LGPs)，用于通过离散受迫 Euler-Lagrange 方程对动力学进行概率式且数据高效的学习。重要的是，在不存在外力时，支配动力系统运动的 Lagrange-d'Alembert 原理的几何结构在构造上得到保留。这使得模型能够学习物理上一致的动力学，从而克服系统能量中的错误漂移，并提供稳定的长期预测。我们方法的核心是用于 Gaussian process 条件化的线性算子，这些算子由离散受迫 Euler-Lagrange 方程和变分离散化方案构造而成。因此，与先前工作不同，该方法能够从离散的位置快照中学习动力学，即无需访问系统的速度或动量。这对于大量实际场景尤其相关，因为这些场景中通常只能获得位置测量，例如 motion capture 或 visual servoing 应用。我们在多种合成和真实案例研究中展示了 LGPs 的数据效率和泛化能力，其中包括一个具有 hysteresis 的真实软体机器人。实验结果强调，LGPs 仅从稀疏的位置数据中就能学习具有不确定性量化的、物理一致的动力学，并实现稳定的长期预测。

items.title: Topology-Driven Anti-Entanglement Control for Soft Robots
items.summary: TD-MARL 用拓扑状态共享与拓扑安全层提升软体多机器人防缠绕控制的训练稳定性和效果。
items.abstract_en: In the field of precision manufacturing in complex constrained environments, the role of soft robots is increasingly prominent, and the realization of anti-winding control based on multi-intelligent body reinforcement learning has become a research hotspot. One of the core problems at present is to coordinate multiple robots to complete the unwinding operation in a highly constrained environment. The existing distributed training framework faces some observability challenges in high-density barrier and unstable environments, resulting in poor learning results. This paper proposes a topology-driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (TD-MARL) framework to coordinate multi-robot systems to avoid entanglement. Specifically, the critical network adopts centralized learning, so that each intelligent body can perceive the strategies of other intelligent bodies by sharing the topological state, thus alleviating the training instability caused by complex interactions; eliminating the demand for communication resources between robots through distributed execution, Upgrade system reliability; the integrated topological security layer uses topological invariants to accurately assess and mitigate the risk of entanglement to avoid the strategy from falling into local difficulties. Finally, the full simulation experiments carried out in the real simulation environment show that the method is better than the current advanced deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method in terms of convergence and anti-winding effect.
items.one_liner_zh: TD-MARL 用拓扑状态共享与拓扑安全层提升软体多机器人防缠绕控制的训练稳定性和效果。
items.summary_cn: 在复杂受限环境中的精密制造领域，软体机器人的作用日益突出，而基于多智能体强化学习实现防缠绕控制已成为研究热点。当前的核心问题之一，是在高度受限的环境中协调多个机器人完成解缠操作。现有分布式训练框架在高密度障碍和不稳定环境中面临一些可观测性挑战，导致学习效果较差。本文提出了一种 topology-driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (TD-MARL) 框架，用于协调多机器人系统避免缠绕。具体而言，关键网络采用集中式学习，使每个智能体能够通过共享拓扑状态感知其他智能体的策略，从而缓解复杂交互导致的训练不稳定性；通过分布式执行消除机器人之间对通信资源的需求，提升系统可靠性；集成的拓扑安全层利用拓扑不变量准确评估并降低缠绕风险，以避免策略陷入局部困境。最后，在真实仿真环境中开展的完整仿真实验表明，该方法在收敛性和防缠绕效果方面优于当前先进的深度强化学习 (DRL) 方法。

items.title: DexSynRefine: Synthesizing and Refining Human-Object Interaction Motion for Physically Feasible Dexterous Robot Actions
items.summary: DexSynRefine 将 HOI 运动合成、残差 RL 与接触动力学适配结合起来，把稀疏人类演示转成可执行的灵巧手操作策略。
items.abstract_en: Learning dexterous manipulation from human-object interaction (HOI) data is a scalable alternative to teleoperation, but HOI demonstrations are sparse and provide only kinematic motion that is not directly executable under embodiment mismatch and contact-rich dynamics. We present DexSynRefine, a framework with three coupled components: HOI-MMFP, a task- and object-initial-state-conditioned extension of motion manifold primitives that synthesizes coordinated hand-object trajectories from sparse HOI demonstrations; a task-space residual RL policy that physically grounds the synthesized reference while inheriting its kinematic structure; and a contact-and-dynamics adaptation module that enables sim-to-real transfer from proprioceptive history. Across five dexterous manipulation tasks spanning pick-and-place, tool use, and object reorientation, our task-space residual policy outperforms prior action-representation baselines in simulations and transfers to a real robot on all five tasks, improving over kinematic retargeting by 50-70 percentage points.
items.one_liner_zh: DexSynRefine 将 HOI 运动合成、残差 RL 与接触动力学适配结合起来，把稀疏人类演示转成可执行的灵巧手操作策略。
items.summary_cn: 从人-物交互（HOI）数据中学习灵巧操作，是相对于遥操作更具可扩展性的替代方案，但 HOI 演示稀疏，并且只提供运动学轨迹，在具身差异和富接触动力学条件下无法直接执行。我们提出 DexSynRefine，一个由三个耦合组件组成的框架：HOI-MMFP，它是 motion manifold primitives 的一个扩展，受任务和物体初始状态条件控制，可从稀疏 HOI 演示中合成协调的手-物轨迹；一个 task-space residual RL policy，用于在继承合成参考运动学结构的同时将其物理落地；以及一个 contact-and-dynamics adaptation 模块，利用本体感觉历史实现 sim-to-real 迁移。在涵盖抓取放置、工具使用和物体重定向的五个灵巧操作任务上，我们的 task-space residual policy 在仿真中优于先前的动作表示基线，并成功迁移到真实机器人上的全部五个任务，相比运动学重定向提升了 50-70 个百分点。

items.title: ReActor: Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Aware Motion Retargeting
items.summary: ReActor 以双层优化联合动作重定向与 RL 跟踪策略训练，为跨形态机器人生成更物理一致的模仿学习参考运动。
items.abstract_en: Retargeting human kinematic reference motion onto a robot's morphology remains a formidable challenge. Existing methods often produce physical inconsistencies, such as foot sliding, self-collisions, or dynamically infeasible motions, which hinder downstream imitation learning. We propose a bilevel optimization framework that jointly adapts reference motions to a robot's morphology while training a tracking policy using reinforcement learning. To make the optimization tractable, we derive an approximate gradient for the upper-level loss. Our framework requires only a sparse set of semantic rigid-body correspondences and eliminates the need for manual tuning by identifying optimal values for a parameterization expressive enough to preserve characteristic motion across different embodiments. Moreover, by integrating retargeting directly with physics simulation, we produce physically plausible motions that facilitate robust imitation learning. We validate our method in simulation and on hardware, demonstrating challenging motions for morphologies that differ significantly from a human, including retargeting onto a quadruped.
items.one_liner_zh: ReActor 以双层优化联合动作重定向与 RL 跟踪策略训练，为跨形态机器人生成更物理一致的模仿学习参考运动。
